_source: Hand-collected for kernel 0.1.0 from the code that reads each dial (backend/plane/crates/orreth-spine/src · spine/orreth_spine · spine/compose.yaml · Dockerfile · scripts/dev.sh). A default of — means the dial has no standing value and is read only when set.

dials.name: SPINE_PG
dials.governs: Where the ground is — the Postgres database this world stands on. The image sets it by service name (ground:5432).

dials.name: SPINE_RABBIT
dials.governs: The invocation rail — RabbitMQ, where work waits for the one body that claims it.

dials.name: SPINE_KAFKA
dials.governs: The events rail — Kafka, where facts are published and replayed. A box reaches it as events:29092.

dials.name: SPINE_SCOPE
dials.governs: The universe this process belongs to. Every row on the ground wears it.

dials.name: SPINE_QUEUE_NS
dials.governs: The namespace for a cell's benches and topics, so two cells on one broker never share a queue.

dials.name: SPINE_CELL
dials.governs: The name of the cell this kernel keeps. A universe's home is settled on the ground at light.

dials.name: SPINE_PEERS
dials.governs: The cells this kernel names, as name=door pairs (two=http://127.0.0.1:4602). Named peers speak over the signed seam.

dials.name: SPINE_POOL
dials.governs: The most lines to the ground a kernel holds open at once; a knock past the ceiling waits for one.

dials.name: SPINE_OUTBOX_KEEP_DAYS
dials.governs: How long published facts stay in the outbox before the hourly prune removes them.

dials.name: SPINE_BRIDGE_PORT
dials.governs: The port the kernel's door answers on.

dials.name: SPINE_BIND
dials.governs: The address the door binds. Loopback on a host; every interface inside a box so the published port reaches it.

dials.name: SPINE_HUMAN_ZONE
dials.governs: The ground's default time zone for a person who has not told it theirs.

dials.name: SPINE_MASTERS
dials.governs: Person DIDs declared masters at birth, comma-separated. A master's seat can govern.

dials.name: SPINE_SEAT_HOURS
dials.governs: How long a person's seat lasts before they prove a code again.

dials.name: SPINE_CEILING_RATE
dials.governs: Knocks a second one person (or one address at an open door) may make before the door says it is busy.

dials.name: SPINE_CEILING_BURST
dials.governs: How many knocks the ceiling lets through at once before the rate applies.

dials.name: SPINE_BODIES
dials.governs: Whether this kernel seats the crew as processes (crew) or none — none beside a lit reference that already seats them.

dials.name: SPINE_CREW
dials.governs: Another crew manifest to seat instead of the standard one.

dials.name: SPINE_PYTHON
dials.governs: The Python interpreter that runs a body.

dials.name: SPINE_JOIN_LEASE_DAYS
dials.governs: How long a body's lease lasts before it re-joins through the desk.

dials.name: SPINE_LEASE_USD
dials.governs: A body's fuel allowance in dollars per window, written into its lease.

dials.name: SPINE_LEASE_RENEW_DAYS
dials.governs: The window the fuel allowance renews in.

dials.name: SPINE_KERNEL_DOOR
dials.governs: Where a spawned body streams its words as they form — the kernel's own door. Set for the body, not by you.

dials.name: SPINE_SPAWN_TICKET
dials.governs: The one-time ticket a spawned body carries to the desk so the crew is admitted on the manifest without a click.

dials.name: SPINE_BODY_EPHEMERAL
dials.governs: Tests only: a body with a throwaway self.

dials.name: SPINE_FAKE_REPLY
dials.governs: Proofs only: the one line the fake mind says while the gateway is dark.

groups.name: The gateway, the Stable and the shelf

dials.name: SPINE_GATEWAY
dials.governs: Where the gateway (LiteLLM) answers. Every thought goes through it.

dials.name: SPINE_GATEWAY_KEY
dials.governs: The gateway's master key, which the kernel uses to mint each body its own virtual key with its budget.

dials.name: SPINE_OLLAMA_BASE
dials.governs: Where Ollama on your machine is reached from a box, for a mind registered with the ollama provider.

dials.name: SPINE_MIND_CHECK_S
dials.governs: The stablekeeper's cadence: how often every mind is pinged and its price and end-of-life read.

dials.name: SPINE_EOL_HORIZON_DAYS
dials.governs: How far ahead the stablekeeper looks for a mind's announced retirement before proposing a swap.

dials.name: SPINE_TOOL_CHECK_S
dials.governs: The toolkeeper's cadence: how often every service on the shelf is probed.

dials.name: SPINE_TOOL_UNHEALTHY_STRIKES
dials.governs: Unhealthy probes in a row before the keeper proposes a retire — it never retires alone.

dials.name: SPINE_SERVICES_HOME
dials.governs: Where the services' own seeds live, so a tool keeps the same self every life.

dials.name: SPINE_MCP_REF · SPINE_MCP_REF_TOOLS
dials.governs: The reference MCP server (a clock) a proof stands on the shelf, and the tools it lists.

dials.name: SPINE_METAL
dials.governs: The metal this ground offers to placement; a template that needs more is refused at birth with the reason recorded.

dials.name: ORRETH_HOME
dials.governs: Where every seed lives — the kernel's self, the crew's, the services'. Keep it on a volume: it is what makes a self survive the process.

dials.name: SPINE_KERNEL_HOME
dials.governs: The directory holding the kernel's own seed.

dials.name: ORRETH_SPINE
dials.governs: The spine home: the crew manifest, the templates, the tool and lever declarations, the guide, the policy.

dials.name: ORRETH_GLASS
dials.governs: The one page the kernel serves.

dials.name: SPINE_PROFILE
dials.governs: dev.sh only: which cargo profile the walk kernel is built with (debug keeps the quick build for a code loop).
